answer: The protocol issues a pearl‑graded reputation token that vests only after a lantern‑timed interval; each new identity must lock a stake of 10 PoA tokens and wait the full interval before any reward can be claimed. During the interval the system records a nadir‑score for each identity based on cumulative uptime and cross‑peer attestations; only when the score exceeds the nadir threshold does the vesting accelerate.
